# Economy Stays

> A calmer way to compare stays. Search hotels, apartments, and vacation rentals in one place and book through travel sites you already know.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.economy-stays.com/): Hotel and stay search
- [Español](https://www.economy-stays.com/es): Spanish home page
- [Português (Brasil)](https://www.economy-stays.com/br): Brazilian Portuguese home page
- [About](https://www.economy-stays.com/about): About Economy Stays
- [Contact](https://www.economy-stays.com/contact): Contact and support
- [Privacy](https://www.economy-stays.com/privacy): Privacy policy

## Sitelink guides

- [Tonight's Hotel Stays](https://www.economy-stays.com/tonight-stays): Browse hotel stays available tonight. Enter a city, see what's listed right now, and head to a booking partner only when you find something that fits.
  - Markdown for AI crawlers: https://www.economy-stays.com/tonight-stays.md
- [Unsold Hotel Rooms Tonight](https://www.economy-stays.com/unsold-rooms-tonight): Browse hotel rooms listed for tonight that haven't sold yet. Enter a city to see what's still available and head to a booking partner to reserve.
  - Markdown for AI crawlers: https://www.economy-stays.com/unsold-rooms-tonight.md
- [Hotel Stays Under $100](https://www.economy-stays.com/stays-under-100): Browse hotel stays within a budget. Search by city and dates, then filter by price on the booking partner's site to find accommodation under $100.
  - Markdown for AI crawlers: https://www.economy-stays.com/stays-under-100.md
- [Half-Price Hotel Stays](https://www.economy-stays.com/half-price-stays): Browse hotels where rates are well below their usual level. Search your dates, compare prices across booking partners, and continue to reserve when a saving looks real.
  - Markdown for AI crawlers: https://www.economy-stays.com/half-price-stays.md
- [Hotel Stays Near Me](https://www.economy-stays.com/stays-near-me): Browse hotel stays near your current location. Allow location access and Economy Stays fills the destination automatically so you can compare nearby accommodation.
  - Markdown for AI crawlers: https://www.economy-stays.com/stays-near-me.md
- [Weekend Away � Hotel Stays](https://www.economy-stays.com/weekend-away): Browse hotel stays for a weekend break. Friday to Sunday is pre-filled � enter a destination to compare accommodation across booking partners.
  - Markdown for AI crawlers: https://www.economy-stays.com/weekend-away.md
